Extra concept cards for M4 (`n2f concept board`, `n2f concept promote`), overlaid on the
bracket example together with `../product-green-red/concepts/` by `tests/unit/test_promote.py`,
`tests/unit/test_board.py` and `tests/e2e/test_concept_promote.py`.
C-003 screens green with a style (appliance, 8 mm corners, hidden-front fasteners), a
supply circuit and a sketch in `refs/`; it is the card the promotion goldens
(`../promote-golden/`) record. C-004 screens red on a 300 mm alcove (door swing included):
promoted with `--override`, its alcove requirement fails against the bracket.
